transcript.message: Hi Maya, thanks for taking the time to chat with me. I'm looking for something authentic and maybe a bit off the beaten path. Could you tell me a bit about what you're considering for my dinner reservation?

Aloha Alex, it's great to chat with you too. I completely understand what you're looking for - an authentic Hawaiian dining experience that's not just another tourist trap. I've got a couple of options in mind, but let me tell you, one place that really stands out to me is Coco. Coco sounds really intriguing, especially with its focus on traditional dishes and community involvement. I'm so glad to hear that, Alex. I just know you're going to love Coco. They really do offer a unique and authentic experience that will give you a true taste of Hawaiian culture.
